headline: Marban Hollow Busiest Ground as Expanse Work Passes to No-Man's-Land
war_summary: The Linn Mercy front has not slackened since the last edition: eight Colonial works, two Warden and one stretch unclaimed, with actions about Outwich Ranch, Lathair and Hardline running into the afternoon and casualties near 197 Colonial and 462 Warden the hour. Marban Hollow is now the busiest ground in the short reckoning, seven actions in two hours and seventeen in the day leaving four works Colonial, three Warden and one neutral about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. In the Weathered Expanse one fewer Warden work is counted than at the last writing, so five stand Warden, one Colonial and three unclaimed, with forty-eight actions logged in the day and losses of roughly 188 Colonial and 285 Warden the hour. Kuura Strand keeps at it, four actions in two hours about Talven and Faden Point, one work still unclaimed. Mooring County's guns, quiet at the previous report, have spoken again — some 385 Colonial and 306 Warden losses the hour, though the line holds at twelve Warden works. Elsewhere the Nevish Line has gone silent for six hours after fifty-four actions in the day, while its losses continue near 456 Colonial and 597 Warden the hour.
